event.title: Q1 2026 program reporting - Lernwerk gGmbH, Essen

reports.text: Q1 lief richtig gut in Essen. We ran the digital skills workshops and about twenty young people were trained and completed the program. The energy was great and the group was motivated. Looking forward to Q2.

Attendance record, Youth Digital Skills, Essen, Q1 2026. Six sessions held (S1-S6). Unique participants across the quarter: 18. Per-session present counts: S1=16, S2=15, S3=14, S4=13, S5=9, S6=12. Source: signed session sheets.

Reminder for the Q1 write-up: report participation as 'attended', not 'trained'. Completion requires the end-of-program assessment (ASSESS form). The ASSESS results for Q1 have NOT been received from Lernwerk yet, so we cannot report anyone as completed this quarter.
Tranche 2 disbursement to Lernwerk gGmbH is pending the approved Q1 narrative report. Please confirm participation and completion figures before sign-off.
